{{Quote|What about the Mandalorians?''"<br />"''Yeah, they bunk at Vlemoth Port, one of those trade backwaters.|A Rebel Alliance operative and [[Skahvi Renlow/Legends|Skahvi Renlow]]|<ref name="FLT" />}}
'''Vlemoth Port''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Instrop sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. An uninhabited world once known only as '''P1S15IS0079''', Vlemoth Port was purchased from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Vlem Hill]], and developed by the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]] into an industrial center. Scattered tribes of displaced [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] could also be found on Vlemoth Port, in addition to an enclave of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] immigrants centered around the [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Arumorut]].

==Description==
Vlemoth Port was located in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along the [[Cranan-Excarga Route/Legends|Cranan-Excarga Route]] in the [[Instrop sector/Legends|Instrop sector]]. A terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] with standard gravity, Vlemoth Port possessed a [[Lung/Legends|breathable]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and a climate that varied by region. A [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on Vlemoth Port comprised two hundred and fifty-six [[Standard day/Legends|days]], and each day was made up of twenty-eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Vlemoth Port possessed a number of [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and rivers stretched across its surface, in addition to expanses of [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] terrain and snowy tundras. Dense forests of [[Conifer/Legends|conifer]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]]—thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high, with thick trunks and hard [[Wood/Legends|wood]]—grew in abundance in the northern foothills of Vlemoth Port. The planet's arctic regions were snow-covered and known to be perilous to anyone who wasn't trained to deal with the [[Winter/Legends|wintry]] conditions.<ref name="FLT" />

Located close to a continent-dividing river on Vlemoth Port sat the industrial city of [[Sanshur Flats]], home to various [[Factory/Legends|facilities]]. Positioned nearby was the towering [[Vlemoth Station]]; an [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Space station/Legends|defense installation]] that had been moved down to the planet's surface, Vlemoth Station became an independent [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] operated by the world's Muun overseers. From the station's upper suites, the Muuns handled all of Vlemoth Port's interplanetary commerce and collected taxes on incoming and outgoing trade. Nearly an hour's flight away, in the forested northern foothills of Vlemoth Port, was the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] settlement of [[Arumorut]], home to over eight hundred Mandalorians specializing in [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] work.<ref name="FLT" />

==History==
{{Quote|Bet you're wondering how an enclave of Mandalonans ended up this far from Mandalore. Ol' Nam Beroya, Vera's father, led us out here. Didn't like the way Mandalore was headed.|[[Teroch/Legends|Teroch]]|<ref name="FLT" />}}
Once an uninhabited planet known only as P1S15IS0079, the Outer Rim world became [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a population of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] after a [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] carrying hundreds of the [[Color/Legends|white]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] crashed there. Over generations, the Talz expanded and divided into multiple tribal groups, establishing villages and occasionally battling over territorial disputes.<ref name="FLT" />

Several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the galaxy-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the planet was purchased from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] industrialist [[Vlem Hill]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Vlemoth Port, as the planet came to be known thereafter, was developed by the [[Hill family]] into an Outer Rim industrial center: the world's numerous undersea [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] were capped with [[mine-spire]]s to filter precious metals, and the industrial manufacturing city of Sanshur Flats was built along a massive [[river]], where it produced [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] for Banking Clan [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]]. During the Clone Wars, the Banking Clan constructed an [[orbital gun platform]] to defend their holdings against Republic attacks. The thousand-meter-tall platform was later grounded on Vlemoth Port's surface, where it came to serve as an independent starport known as Vlemoth Station.<ref name="FLT" />

Amidst the intersocietal struggles between the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] and the violently radical [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a [[Old Mandalorians|number of Mandalorians]] from the traditional [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] elected to leave behind<ref name="FLT" /> their people's cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and its strife to settle on Vlemoth Port. Taking up residence in the conifer forests of the planet's northern foothills, the Mandalorians and their leader, [[Nam Beroya]], established a settlement of their own they deemed Arumorut. From there, they contracted out their services as mercenaries and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] throughout the surrounding region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The Mandalorian and the Talz populations developed a complex relationship: some of the Talz viewed the Mandalorians as intruders to be fought, while other groups such as the [[Gnaaz tribe]] allied with the Mandalorians for mutual benefit, training and participating in festivities together.<ref name="FLT" />

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Empire nationalized Vlemoth Port and sold its resources to various independent [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]]. However, the Muuns spent years quietly buying the planet back in order to recover the wealth that had accumulated from Vlemoth Port's volcanic mining efforts below the sea.<ref name="FLT" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the forces of the rebellious [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], [[Skypath Industries]] offered a payment of five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to transport twenty [[Metric ton/Legends|tons]] of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] from [[Dravian Starport|Dravian Station]] to Vlemoth Port.<ref name="TSB">{{WEGCite|story=Tales of the Smoking Blaster|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook|stext=Tales of the ''Smoking Blaster''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Vlemoth Port was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[West End Games]] adventure "[[Tales of the Smoking Blaster]]," written by [[Bill Smith]] and published in [[1993]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]''.<ref name="TSB" /> Twenty three years later, Vlemoth Port was featured again in the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', released on [[December 8]], [[2016]].<ref name="FLT" />
